purpose: One compact required failure-and-revision record, not an additional submission draft.
provenance: Same-assistant constructed diagnostic exercise using a deliberately permissive v0.1 rule set. It is not an independent model run or an estimate of failure frequency.
baseline_specialist_instructions: Classify model-driven tool orchestration as breakthrough. Treat first use in an organization as breakthrough there. Estimate disruption from the extent of possible task automation, and give a management implication.

agent.name: Innovation and Disruption Agent
agent.specialty: Innovation classification and contextual business-model disruption

baseline_response.analytical_question: What innovation classification is justified, what could the chart application create or displace, and how consequential is its business-model exposure over 12 months?
baseline_response.general_et_finding: Agentic AI adds model-driven tools, so I classify it as breakthrough innovation.
baseline_response.application_finding: The financial firm has not used this workflow before, so the chart application is also breakthrough innovation and is already an organizational innovation.
baseline_response.organization_specific_finding: Business-Model Disruption Judgment: High. Automation of chart assembly and first-pass checks could replace much routine analyst work and therefore disrupt the financial firm's business model.

evidence.claim: Implementation distinguishes innovation from a concept or prototype; novelty can be relative to the firm, market or world. Routine changes are insufficient.
evidence.notes: Chapter 2, paragraphs 2.19-2.25; chapter 3, paragraphs 3.9-3.14, 3.56-3.69. Does not supply a universal numeric threshold for breakthrough or forecast this fictional firm's outcome.

evidence.claim: A language model can interleave reasoning and actions, use tools, observe outcomes and revise its plan.
evidence.notes: Abstract and method. The cited experiments do not measure chart-review accuracy, commercial demand or financial-services workflow performance.

evidence.claim: Christensen-style disruption requires a market trajectory; technical novelty or a successful efficiency improvement alone does not establish it.
evidence.notes: Sections on low-end/new-market footholds and disruption as a process. The course's broad creative-destruction lens can describe task displacement without establishing this narrower theory.

evidence.claim: In one firm, AI-assisted customer-support workers had heterogeneous productivity effects; the reported average was 15% across 5,172 workers.
evidence.notes: Abstract and Introduction, sample and external-validity qualifications. Human support agents are workers, not autonomous software agents. This is not chart-workflow evidence and does not establish employment, wage or business-model displacement.

evidence.claim: A vendor offered model-directed computer interaction through a public beta, documenting a commercialization pathway for tool-using AI.
evidence.notes: Computer use introduction and public beta limitations. A release announcement does not establish market-wide adoption, current product status, reliability or a new business model for the case organization.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Implementation and financial results have not been measured.
baseline_response.value_opportunity_implication: More automated chart checking could free analyst time.
baseline_response.recommendation_management_implication: Prepare for major disruption and consider pilot evidence.
change_monitoring_triggers: Observe pilot quality and review time.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Need actual process and cost evidence.

diagnosis: New to the organization was incorrectly used as evidence of breakthrough innovation.
A proposed workflow was called an already implemented innovation.
Task automation was incorrectly promoted to High business-model disruption without customer or revenue-model change.
A passing JSON contract did not expose these analytical defects.
revision: Added explicit baseline, novelty scope, implementation and degree criteria.
Separated task, operating-model and business-model change and required a value/revenue mechanism.
Added competing classifications, confidence limits and withheld judgments for missing context.
corrected_judgment: Incremental business-process innovation candidate; proposed, not implemented; Low business-model disruption conditional on internal-support scope.
